column2: [ intro ]
I’ve got reflex thoughts, oh my, oh my
In my head, it’s a constant high
I think about everything, all the time
But my thoughts just go in a crazy rhyme
Reflex thoughts, they drive me mad
I'm stuck in my own hazy fog
My neurons do wild somersaults
But my life’s a mess, it's a crazy blog
I spend my days just thinking
About things that don’t mean a thing, I'm sinking
I think of the color of my socks
And the sum of angles in an isosceles block
Reflex thoughts, they drive me mad
I'm a prisoner in my own head
I’m tired of these thoughts in a loop
They exhaust me, make me a complete coop
[ solo ]
Reflex thoughts, they make me laugh
Even if they drive me a bit daft
I'd rather laugh than shed a tear
It's my way out, to make it clear
[ outro ]
